source: You've begun a new job as a janitor at a ----school. The laughter of children can be heard in the air. You settle down in your new office and discover a DVD in a case. It's an introduction to two ----school students Manami and Chika. There's a hint on how to find more videos. Follow the clues and find the DVDs that show the sexual nature of what went on before ...
translation: 你得到了一份新的校工工作。空氣中迴盪著孩子們的笑聲。你在自己的辦公室安頓下來，發現盒中裝著一張DVD。內容介紹了兩名學生愛美和千佳，還暗藏著尋找更多影片的提示。循著線索，找出那些記錄著此前種種性事的DVD……
